findings.why_not_priced: A nano-cap with 35,620 shares of average daily volume and no analyst coverage anywhere in the capture (n_queries=0 in every sweep) does not clear a strategy reversal in one session. The specific unpriced element is the character of the reset - abandoning late-stage assets for an early-stage restart destroys the 'cash-rich late-stage biotech with zero debt' thesis the shareholder base was holding, and that re-rating takes days in an illiquid name. If it were priced, the stock would not have needed a 1-for-8 reverse split three weeks ago to stay listed.

findings.why_not_priced: Shelf housekeeping filings are invisible to every aggregator, and a POS AM landing on the same day as results is the mechanical prerequisite for continuing to sell stock immediately afterwards. In a name whose float has just been divided by eight, at-the-market supply against 35k shares a day of natural liquidity is the dominant price-setting force and nothing publishes it.
